text: No, this property was not deforested. The 67.7 ha of tree cover loss in 2020 occurred *before* the baseline date (December 31, 2020) for the claim interval (2021–2025). The JRC 2020 forest map confirms the asset had **0 ha of forest** as of 2020, meaning it was already deforested by then. The claim evaluated post-baseline loss (2021–2025), and no additional loss events ≥0.5 ha were detected during that period. The asset met the EUDR definition of deforestation-free at the 2020 baseline.
